video_title: Cowboys Are Cooked... Kyle Shanahan's 49ers Are SCARY

quotes.speaker: Willie McGinest
quotes.summary_phrase: USC's path to the college football playoffs
quotes.excerpt: You guys could lose the last couple games and still get into the playoffs.
quotes.quote: You guys could lose the last couple games and still get into the playoffs.

quotes.speaker: Willie McGinest
quotes.summary_phrase: Criticism of college football playoff rankings
quotes.excerpt: I don't like the way they're dropping teams.
quotes.quote: I don't like the way they're dropping teams. Remember Indiana was on a bye and they was ranked fourth to fifth and dropped to like ninth or something without even playing. They was on a bye. So, what are your thoughts on like the two-win teams that are still ranked high?

quotes.speaker: Willie McGinest
quotes.summary_phrase: Evaluating two-loss teams in the college football playoff rankings
quotes.excerpt: I don't have a problem with that, as long as they're really good teams.
quotes.quote: I don't have a problem with that, as long as they're really good teams. If you're playing power teams every week and you're losing or it's close games, then I don't have a problem with that. If you're losing to bullshit teams or teams you should beat, then that's a different story. So, I would then kind of sway towards power schedule and look at that.

quotes.speaker: Willie McGinest
quotes.summary_phrase: USC's need for consistency and excellence
quotes.excerpt: We're not where we want to be. It ain't no excuses. I'm not one to make excuses.
quotes.quote: We're not where we want to be. It ain't no excuses. I'm not one to make excuses for this program, regardless of how much talent they have or where the expectations are supposed to be. You got to play the game, you got to win, you got to play a certain way, and if that's not happening, then they got to figure things out.

quotes.speaker: Willie McGinest
quotes.summary_phrase: The need for USC to establish a new identity
quotes.excerpt: Until you get back to what SC was, this is not the old SC.
quotes.quote: Until you get back to what SC was, this is not the old SC. So everybody's expectations is what was in the past. And I think it's time to create what is now and get back to consistency and excellence, whatever that looks like now.

quotes.speaker: Willie McGinest
quotes.summary_phrase: The impact of conference realignment on college football
quotes.excerpt: You look forward to having those bragging rights and saying we're the champions of our conference.
quotes.quote: You look forward to having those bragging rights and saying we're the champions of our conference. Now we going to further play. It's still the same in high school, it's still the same in professional sports in the NFL. Division champs, conference champs, now Super Bowl champs. That's how it works. So that shit kind of matters.

quotes.speaker: Willie McGinest
quotes.summary_phrase: The Chargers' win over the Ravens
quotes.excerpt: It's good for the Chargers. They really needed that.
quotes.quote: It's good for the Chargers. They really needed that. They was on life support when it came to their schedule and what they've been doing and the talent that they acquired that everybody thought what they were going to be and what they really are. So, they needed it. As far as the Ravens, man, I didn't take what Kyle Hamilton said out of context. I get what he's saying. I know the standard. I played in that division. I know the standard what they've been, but again, that Ravens is different. They had a lot of injuries. They're not playing how they used to play, how they used to play and all those different things. So, until you get back to that, you got to say we are, and in the famous words of Dennis Green, we are who we thought we were until you change that.

quotes.speaker: Willie McGinest
quotes.summary_phrase: The Lions' dominance and Drake Maye's injury
quotes.excerpt: I took the Lions. The Lions are going in a whole different direction.
quotes.quote: I took the Lions. The Lions are going in a whole different direction. And because of all the injuries, because of the inconsistency with Drake Maye who unfortunately got hurt in this game, could possibly be out for the season, and the other injuries they had across the O-line and everything else, I took the Lions. The Lions are going in a whole different direction. And right now, as competitive as the NFC North is, Detroit is in first place.

quotes.speaker: Willie McGinest
quotes.summary_phrase: The difficulty of turning around a struggling team
quotes.excerpt: If you're not heading in the right direction or you're trending or you're below 500, you are who you are.
quotes.quote: If you're not heading in the right direction or you're trending or you're below 500, you are who you are. And it's going to be tough to fix it because a lot of these teams that are getting better and going in the right direction, they just start pulling away. So it makes it tougher, as you know. They're pulling away.

quotes.speaker: Willie McGinest
quotes.summary_phrase: The mental toughness of the 49ers
quotes.excerpt: I think the mental toughness, I think the physicality, I think the ability to overcome whatever's going on.
quotes.quote: I think the mental toughness, I think the physicality, I think the ability to overcome whatever's going on in the building, injuries. The head coach was in a big ass accident. It didn't keep him off the field. That shit resonates downhill to your team. He says, 'I'm going to be on the sideline coaching, don't worry about me.' And when you look at the way they play, how physical they are, um, how prepared they are, and when you have one of the best football minds and play callers that's able to scheme the shit out of people, it makes them a dangerous team.

quotes.speaker: Willie McGinest
quotes.summary_phrase: The importance of staying healthy for the 49ers
quotes.excerpt: The only caveat is can they stay healthy to consistently keep their playmakers on the field.
quotes.quote: The only caveat is can they stay healthy to consistently keep their playmakers on the field.

quotes.speaker: Willie McGinest
quotes.summary_phrase: The rarity of dual-threat running backs
quotes.excerpt: Those dudes are rare because they're not only running backs, they're a threat at the receiver position.
quotes.quote: Those dudes are rare because they're not only running backs, they're a threat at the receiver position. They're dual threats. So, when you're scheming and they're also the third-down back, a lot of times the packages on defense change. You put in the safety, they could probably bring them back in the formation and run the ball or do whatever. You bring in a bigger guy to kind of do that. Like you saw, you bring in a linebacker, you see the mismatch. So, I think what we used to do is understand where our strengths and weaknesses are, and our staff never put players in a bad position.

quotes.speaker: Willie McGinest
quotes.summary_phrase: The strategic use of Christian McCaffrey
quotes.excerpt: Von Miller being in coverage against Christian McCaffrey in zero coverage with no fucking help over the top.
quotes.quote: Von Miller being in coverage against Christian McCaffrey in zero coverage with no fucking help over the top. I don't care what Kyle is scheming, what his scheme is. If Von Miller is in the game, and I was going back and forth with Lev Bell, because he said, 'No, it's scheme, it's scheme.' It is scheme, but I'm not going to let you scheme me. Do you understand? We're playing chess. So, if Von is in the game, it's to play the run or rush. It's never going to be stand up and go one-on-one in space with Christian McCaffrey with no help.

quotes.speaker: Willie McGinest
quotes.summary_phrase: Christian McCaffrey's Hall of Fame status
quotes.excerpt: Christian McCaffrey is a Hall of Famer, but as a coach, you got to sometimes save us from ourselves.
quotes.quote: Christian McCaffrey is a Hall of Famer, but as a coach, you got to sometimes save us from ourselves. Absolutely.

quotes.speaker: Willie McGinest
quotes.summary_phrase: Patrick Mahomes' impact on the Chiefs' offense
quotes.excerpt: If you got Patrick Mahomes as your quarterback, you kind of find it hard as fuck not to be productive.
quotes.quote: If you got Patrick Mahomes as your quarterback, you kind of find it hard as fuck not to be productive. If you got Patrick Mahomes, right? So prior to this week, it was non-existent of production from the receiver position. So they go out and they get Josh, they trade for Josh Downs from the Colts, and now all of a sudden, everybody and their mama's out there making plays.

quotes.speaker: Willie McGinest
quotes.summary_phrase: The Chiefs' potential in the AFC
quotes.excerpt: I never count them out because of the way they're coached on both sides of the ball.
quotes.quote: I never count them out because of the way they're coached on both sides of the ball. And you got Patrick Mahomes, you got Kenneth Walker, you got a good, you got a nucleus, you got a system. You just got to get players to play within that system. And we saw guys step up this week. So, now we expect when Kenneth Walker comes back, and if you can get Rice going, if you get some of these other receivers going, they're going to be all right.

quotes.speaker: Willie McGinest
quotes.summary_phrase: Comparing Patrick Mahomes and Tom Brady
quotes.excerpt: His arm strength and his arm talent, I would say is probably better.
quotes.quote: His arm strength and his arm talent, I would say is probably better. And Tom would probably tell you the same thing. But I haven't been in the locker room with Mahomes, but I know his psyche, I know his mental. I've been with Tom. And Tom, like his mentality, he's a fucking dog. And that dog comes out. He's politically correct, you know, when he's doing interviews and all that other shit, but Tom's a killer. And Tom will tell you, I sacrifice parts of my life so I can play this way.

quotes.speaker: Willie McGinest
quotes.summary_phrase: Tough quarterbacks to prepare for
quotes.excerpt: In my division alone when I came in as a rookie was Jim Kelly, was Peyton Manning and Marino.
quotes.quote: In my division alone when I came in as a rookie was Jim Kelly, was Peyton Manning and Marino. Those were just three in my division alone. I'm not going to mention playing against Aikman, Steve Young, played against Montana, I played against Warren Moon, I played against Cunningham, I played against John Elway, Cole Pepper, Elway. Yeah. That was a golden era of quarterbacks. Damn, like yeah, like every every week. It was something new. It was a fucking Hall of Famer.

quotes.speaker: Willie McGinest
quotes.summary_phrase: Peyton Manning's football IQ
quotes.excerpt: He was probably the most like his student of the game, his IQ, bro.
quotes.quote: He was probably the most like his student of the game, his IQ, bro. He knew what the defensive coordinator five years ago used to like to eat for breakfast and shit. Like he was a beast. Like he he was one of those dudes, like it was seriously chess every series. Something was changing. And he did his homework. He knew everything. He knew how to scheme, he was smart. And again, those type of quarterbacks, you don't have to have all the athletic ability, but up here they got it all.

quotes.speaker: Willie McGinest
quotes.summary_phrase: Giannis Antetokounmpo playing against the Bucks
quotes.excerpt: I want to look at Wednesday's game, Giannis playing his former team the Bucks.
quotes.quote: I want to look at Wednesday's game, Giannis playing his former team the Bucks. It's in Miami. How we feeling about Giannis playing against his former team and points, rebounds, assist, pick one of those stats that you think that he's going to just come out.
